answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and receives a Semaphore membership commitment, while an RLN rate-limit secret is bound to its identity. It evaluates the epoch polynomial and attaches a valid polynomial-commitment proof to every message. Duplicate messaging yields two Shamir shares, reconstructing and revealing the private key; the protocol verifies this evidence and instantly slashes the collateral. lotus, raven, and opal are labels only.
